# RFQ Intake — Project Status Snapshot

**Generated:** 2026-06-26  
**Sources:** `Planning/PRD.md`, `Planning/ADD.md`, `Planning/IMPLEMENTATION.md`, `Planning/TESTING.md`, codebase audit  
**Do not edit PRD/ADD with this file** — this is a point-in-time progress report.

---

## Executive summary

| Lens | Completion | Notes |
|------|------------|-------|
| **Plugin repo (M1–M5 scope)** | **~58%** | Backend intake API is essentially done; customer-facing React form and WordPress embed are not started |
| **Backend only (Phases 0–4)** | **~95%** | REST, S3, submit/receipt, admin, webhook — minor ops gaps remain |
| **Frontend (Phase 5–6)** | **~5%** | Vite + Tailwind scaffold + placeholder mount only |
| **Acceptance criteria (`AC-WP-*`)** | **16 / 28 mapped (~57%)** | 12 criteria blocked on frontend, ops cron, or E2E |
| **Full product incl. ERP (M6)** | **~48%** | ERP import worker lives in a separate repo (out of scope here) |

**Bottom line:** Sandcastle/AFK agents have delivered **M1 → M2 → M3** (WordPress REST + S3 + submit durability). The project is **past the “prove the receipt story” gate** but **has not started M4/M5** (shortcode embed + multi-step React form). Nothing is customer-shippable yet because there is no `[rfq_form]` and no real UI.

**Tests today:** 73 PHPUnit unit tests passing; 17 test classes; 138 test methods across unit + integration. CI runs `php-unit`, `pre-merge` (wp-env integration + optional S3 E2E), and `webhook-e2e`.

### §3.6 Fallback behavior reference

| Scenario | Status |
|----------|--------|
| WP down → Airtable on page load | ❌ Needs React health check |
| WP down mid-session → retry submit | ❌ Needs React |
| Page refresh → new session, contact retained in DB | ⚠️ Backend ready; UI not built |
| S3 upload fail → per-file retry | ❌ Needs React |
| S3 fail at submit → retry without re-upload | ⚠️ Backend ready; UI not built |
| ERP/webhook down at submit | ✅ Backend proven |
| JWT expiry mid-session → silent refresh | ⚠️ Backend ready; UI not built |

## Gaps that should have landed with past milestones

These were specified for M1–M3 per `TESTING.md` but are **not present yet**:

| Gap | Expected by | Impact |
|-----|-------------|--------|
| `scripts/check-acceptance-coverage.php` | M1 | No automated AC mapping enforcement |
| `tests/contract/schemas/` JSON schemas | M1 | Contract CI job missing |
| `lint` CI job (PHPCS, PHPStan, ESLint, tsc) | M1 | Static analysis not gated |
| TESTING.md §5.1 S3 PUT validation report | M2 spike | All rows still `_TBD_` |
| Orphan manifest cron / alert (`AC-WP-025`) | M3–M4 | PRD §3.4 step 10, §5.1 monitoring |
| 30-day unreceipted cleanup detection (`AC-WP-026`) | M3 | PRD §3.3.3 lifecycle |
| `@covers AC-WP-*` docblocks | M1+ | Tests use `#[Group('AC-WP-*')]` instead — functionally OK but coverage script may expect docblocks |

None of these block continuing to M4, but they are **tech debt from M1–M3** that pre-release gates will require.

## Completion percentage methodology

| Method | Formula | Result |
|--------|---------|--------|
| IMPLEMENTATION steps (Phases 0–6) | 20 complete + 0.5 partial of 30 steps | **~68%** of planned build steps |
| Milestones M1–M5 (plugin only) | M1 + M2 + M3 done; M4 + M5 not | **60%** (3/5) |
| `AC-WP-*` with automated backend coverage | 16 fully covered + 2 partial of 28 | **~57%** |
| **Weighted V1 plugin shippability** | Backend ~55% of effort @ 95% + Frontend ~40% @ 5% + Test infra ~5% @ 60% | **~58%** |

The weighted figure is the best single “where are we?” number for **this repository’s V1 plugin**. Full end-to-end RFQ intake including ERP import is **~48%** when M6 is included.
